Method of Attack: Buffer overflow vulnerability allowing remote code execution
Execution of arbitrary commands via malicious OLE objects embedded in Office documents
Launching executable files from attacker-controlled WebDAV servers
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Windows versions released in the past 17 years
Attack Vector: Malicious Office documents containing equations created with the old Equation Editor
Embedding malicious OLE objects exploiting the buffer overflow in EQNEDT32.EXE
Indicators of Compromise: OLE objects exploiting EQNEDT32.EXE buffer overflow
Popup prompting to open files in Protected View mode for documents with old Equation Editor equations
